title: Data-Scientific Document System
designPhilosophy: Structured, numbered, clinical precision. Treat legal/info pages like scientific documentation with clear taxonomy, table-format data summaries, and monospaced section identifiers for scanability.

changes: Replace plain text breadcrumb with badge-style segments: each item gets bg-[#1a1f2e] rounded-md px-2.5 py-1 border border-white/[0.06]
Active (last) item uses bg-[#1d9bf0]/10 text-[#1d9bf0] border-[#1d9bf0]/20 font-medium
Separator: ChevronRight replaced with a small slash '/' in text-[#8b92a5]/40 font-mono to evoke file-path / taxonomy feel
Home item prefixed with a tiny Database or FileText icon from lucide-react (h-3 w-3) for visual anchor
breadcrumb.codeSample: {items.map((item, index) => { const isLast = index === items.length - 1; return ( {index > 0 && /} {item.href && !isLast ? ( {item.name} ) : ( {item.name} )} ); })}

changes: Replace border-l-[3px] border-indigo-400/70 with a monospaced section number badge + teal accent
Section number: font-mono text-xs bg-[#1d9bf0]/10 text-[#1d9bf0] rounded px-1.5 py-0.5 mr-2 inline-block
Heading text: text-base font-bold text-[#e6e8ee] (slightly smaller than current lg for density)
Add a subtle bottom border: border-b border-white/[0.06] pb-3 mb-4 to each heading for separation
sectionHeadings.codeSample: 01 基本方針

changes: Convert the 'collected data' list in privacy page into a structured table with columns: Data Type | Storage | Sent to Server
Table styled with: border border-white/[0.06] rounded-lg overflow-hidden, header row bg-[#1a1f2e], body rows bg-transparent
Server column shows a green Shield icon for 'no' (data stays local) to reinforce trust
This replaces the simple <ul> bullet list with a more scientific, precise format

This gives a structured, database-record feel to operator information

changes: Change icon background from bg-indigo-500/15 to bg-[#1d9bf0]/10, icon color to text-[#1d9bf0]
Email button: border-[#1d9bf0]/20 bg-[#1d9bf0]/10 text-[#1d9bf0] hover:border-[#1d9bf0]/40 hover:bg-[#1d9bf0]/20

All internal/external links: replace text-indigo-300 with text-[#1d9bf0]
Underline: decoration-[#1d9bf0]/30 hover:decoration-[#1d9bf0]/70

Add a subtle page-type badge above h1: text-[10px] uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-[#1d9bf0] font-mono mb-2
Badge text per page: 'ABOUT' / 'PRIVACY POLICY' / 'TERMS OF SERVICE' / 'CONTACT'

changes: Wrap update date in a badge-style element: inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-[#1a1f2e] border border-white/[0.06] px-3 py-1 text-xs text-[#8b92a5]
Prefix with Calendar icon (lucide-react, h-3 w-3) for visual clarity

expectedEffects: Monospaced section numbers and badge breadcrumbs create a structured, taxonomy-driven reading experience
Privacy data table provides at-a-glance clarity on what data is collected and where it stays
Teal (#1d9bf0) accent unifies all pages under the scientific/data-visualization brand identity
Document-classification labels (ABOUT, PRIVACY POLICY, etc.) reinforce authority and professionalism
Operator info grid layout looks like a structured database record, enhancing trust
